claude.rationale: gap_45 = 0: the acquired core (mine complexes, mineral rights, fixed and mobile equipment, logistics assets, working capital, and assigned leases/contracts under APA Item 2.01) moved together with the operations that produce and deliver the coal — product and its operating processes crossed the boundary as a self-sustaining bundle, not a product severed from its process. gap_56 = 1: the operating assets/processes transferred to Contura, but employees did NOT transfer automatically (§9.02(a): only Buyer-elected "Offered Employees" who accepted became "Transferred Employees"; unselected employees and severance stayed seller-side), and no employee benefit/ERISA plans were assumed (§9.01(f)/§9.02(b)), so the people/culture layer did not align coherently alongside the transferred processes at closing. gap_mitigated = yes: the documents included a Transition Services Agreement dated as of the Closing Date between Buyer, Alpha and ReorgCo (definition; §2.09/§7.11), a closing-time arrangement allocating the shared substrate. Coded strictly from closing structure; new lender-formed entity Contura installs new controlling intent (T1 replace) via a §363 sale into a swapped legal vehicle (T3 swap).

gemini.rationale: The transaction transferred specific self-sustaining mine complexes (T4/T5) together, so there is no gap_45. However, employees did not transfer automatically; the buyer had to select 'Offered Employees' and all benefit plans were left behind, creating a structural friction/gap at T6 (gap_56 = 1). This gap was mitigated by a Transition Services Agreement signed at closing.

grok.rationale: gap_45=0 because the Stalking Horse APA transferred the designated mine-complex product assets together with the fixed/mobile equipment, logistics assets, mineral rights and assigned contracts that produce and deliver them, so T4 and T5 crossed as one Reserve Price Assets package. gap_56=1 because the same closing structure expressly provided that employees did not transfer automatically (Buyer only offered selected Business Employees; Sellers terminated them at closing; non-accepted employees and all severance stayed with NonCoreCo/ReorgCo) and that Buyer assumed no Seller employee benefit plans, which were transferred to ReorgCo before closing—leaving T5 assets/processes separated from T6 people/plans at the ownership boundary. That people/process mismatch was contractually absorbed at closing by the Transition Services Agreement delivered as a closing deliverable among Buyer, Alpha and ReorgCo.
